theme: Dark Mode (Cybernetic Hong Kong Nightlife & High-Density Tactical POS)

layout_and_navigation.mode: Lightspeed-inspired Ultra-Tactile High Density Grid POS
layout_and_navigation.sidebar: Left fixed icon/text rail for lightning-quick view switches: [Floorplan], [Register / Order Pad], [Menu Mgmt], [CRM / Members], [Staff & Roles], [Live Sports & Events], [Reports & Insights]
layout_and_navigation.top_bar: Live Hong Kong Time (11:00 AM - 06:00 AM shift tracker), Active Staff PIN badge, Quick Search bar (orders/members), Emergency/Service status toggle

login_screen.mode: Staff Authentication with Quick PIN Pad
features: Numeric Touch Screen PIN Pad (4-digit quick switch)

capabilities: Interactive canvas grid with draggable/resizable tables & obstacle elements (Bar Counter, Darts Area, Stage, TV Screen)
Live status indicators (Available, Occupied, Bill Requested, Dirty, Reserved) with spending timer & current balance
Floorplan Edit mode toggle to place/delete/reposition tables

order_taking_register.layout: 3-column split: Left (Categories & Subcategories), Center (Product Cards & Variants Grid), Right (Live Bill Slip + Hold/Fire Controls)
features: Hold & Fire courses (Starter, Main, Dessert, Drink Round) with delayed kitchen/bar dispatch timers
Variant modal (e.g. Beer: Pint vs Tower vs Bucket; Steak: Rare/Medium/Well)
Modifiers & Custom Notes (Extra Lime, No Ice, Less Sugar)
Discount Panel (% discount, flat HKD cash discount, manager override badge)
Order types: Dine-In (linked to table), Pick-Up, Delivery

modes: Split Bill (By Seat, By Equal Parts, By Custom Amount)

features: VIP status tiers & Lifetime HKD spend tracking
Visit history, favorite drinks/items log, average seating duration
Loyalty points redemption & targeted event invitations
Happy Hour Automation Rules (e.g., Mon-Sun 4pm-9pm 20% off Craft Beers & House Spirits)
TV Live Sports Channel Schedule board
Darts Machine queue & active match score log
Trivia Night registration & team table mapper

charts: Sales by Category (Drinks vs Food vs Darts/Events)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive buttons and elements include a standard `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='floorplan-switch-area-backroom', data-testid='order-item-add-button', data-testid='pin-pad-submit').
Keep styling responsive and touch-screen ready with min 44px tap targets for fast bar staff usage.
Do not use transparent dropdown or popover backgrounds; always use dark solid background (#121824) with crisp contrast borders (#26334D).
Use Lucide React icons for tactical POS navigation and table state indicators.
Ensure Sonner toasts are used for order confirmation, kitchen fire alerts, and payment receipts.
